verification.subject: Confirm your email for Argent
verification.intro: Hi. To finish creating your Argent account, confirm your email address.
verification.expiry: The link expires in 24 hours and works only once.
verification.ignore: If you did not create an Argent account, ignore this message.

password_reset.subject: Reset your Argent password
password_reset.intro: Hi. We received a request to reset the password of your Argent account.
password_reset.expiry: The link expires in 60 minutes and works only once.
password_reset.ignore: If you did not ask for it, ignore this message: your password stays the same.

two_factor_enabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is on for your Argent account
two_factor_enabled.body: Hi. Two-factor authentication was turned on for your Argent account, and every other session was signed out.
two_factor_enabled.advice: If you did not do this, reset your password right away: someone else may have access to your account.

two_factor_disabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is off for your Argent account
two_factor_disabled.body: Hi. Two-factor authentication was turned off for your Argent account, and every other session was signed out.
two_factor_disabled.advice: If you did not do this, reset your password and turn two-factor authentication on again right away: someone else may have access to your account.
